DIAGNOSIS READY: Vasovagal Syncope (Micturition Syncope)

The loss of consciousness occurred immediately after urination, a classic presentation for micturition syncope caused by a sudden drop in blood pressure. The normal ECG and lack of cardiac symptoms further support a non-cardiac etiology. Given the rapid recovery without confusion or incontinence, this clinical picture is highly consistent with a benign vasovagal reflex triggered by bladder emptying.
